text:
Maya: Quick preflight for tonight's micro schema change: kv.record.meta made nullable + telemetry tag rename. Coordinating cross-service pins: API, Runtime, Router, Console. Locking plan here.
Sam: I'll take API + Runtime pin and do the initial smoke.
Aaron: Router on me. Need to validate header split predicate and any route rewrite.
Jen: Console ready; small metric name change (telemetry.v2). I'll stage release notes and migration snippet.
Maya: Canary cadence: 1% traffic -> hold 15m -> 5% -> hold 25m -> 25% -> observe 30m -> ramp to 100. Rollback triggers: +0.5% absolute 5xx, or p99 latency +30% sustained 5m. ops-oncall ack?
ops-oncall: acked. I'll have dashboards up and will escalate to page if error spikes exceed threshold.
Sam: Pins proposed: API=v2.3.1-schema-nullable, Runtime=v1.9.0-quant-kv, Router=header-split-0326, Console=v0.45.2-telemetry.
Aaron: Note: header-split-0326 adds a compatibility shim; router config needs a predicate tweak (will push patch). No KV eviction changes.
Maya: deploy-bot, please create canary wave with manual holds. Include explicit pin assignment per service.
deploy-bot: Creating canary wave per request. Wave ID: db-wave-7729991234. Steps: 1% -> hold 15m -> 5% -> hold 25m -> 25% -> observe 30m -> ramp. Pins applied: API=v2.3.1-schema-nullable, Runtime=v1.9.0-quant-kv, Router=header-split-0326, Console=v0.45.2-telemetry. Manual hold after first two waves.
Jen: Release notes draft: "kv.record.meta is now nullable. Console telemetry tag renamed to telemetry.v2. API continues to accept legacy shape (compat mode)." Draft link: https://go/docs/releases/db-wave-7729991234 (will update).
Sam: API smoke steps: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"text":"smoke test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
verify 200 for canonical prompts
compare p99 to baseline (allowed +30%)
validate sample kv read/write for nullable meta
```
Aaron: Router smoke: run route-test.sh against staging routers to ensure x-kv-meta header routing works. I'll run after patch.
Maya: Contingency: if runtime resource conflict prevents pin, fallback is to pin API+Router+Console and keep runtime at prior stable variant; perform node warmup and rerun smoke.
ops-oncall: Also set alerting: 5xx > 0.5% -> page. p99 > +50% -> page. I'll mute non-critical noisy alerts for rollout window.
Sam: Rollback sequence: 1) pause traffic steering in router, 2) pin all services back to previous stable tags, 3) flush relevant caches/prefixes if corruption suspected, 4) open incident channel #incident-db-wave-7729991234.
Maya: Schedule: dry-run pins at 01:30 UTC (no traffic), actual rollout start 02:00 UTC (change window).
Jen: I'll gate the console release notes merge until 04:00 UTC if all green. Pushing docs with migration snippet now.
Aaron: I'll be on standby to revert router changes within 5m if needed.
Sam: I'll monitor API metrics and handle quick rollbacks if triggers hit. Staying for first 45m.
Maya: Any overlooked dependencies?
Jen: Analytics consumer uses telemetry.v2; adding feature toggle to avoid breaking consumers during canary.
Maya: Great. deploy-bot, schedule for 1700013600 (02:00 UTC) and post progress to this thread.
deploy-bot: Scheduled db-wave-7729991234 for 1700013600. Will post live roll updates. :rocket:
ops-oncall: Dashboards ready and pinned. Ping for manual throttle.
Maya: Thanks team. We'll capture a short postmortem for any anomalies. If all passes, I'll finalize release notes after window.
Sam: 👍
Aaron: 👍
Jen: 👍
